variable.description: (Required) ULID of the target version to re-apply

request.description: Re-apply a prior version's content (config + test-case grid) to the live test set. A revert is forward-only: it mints a new version (change_type=revert) and advances the test set, so the response reflects the test set's new live config. Reverting to the version the test set already points at is rejected with 400. Test cases are not included in the response; fetch them separately via GET /test-cases.

response.name: Test set reverted successfully

request.description: Associate one or more agents with a test set. The operation is idempotent: already-associated agents are a no-op, and unknown or inactive agent IDs are ignored. The response reflects the resulting association set, so callers can confirm which IDs took effect.

query.description:
Filter expression syntax.
Values may be unquoted or double-quoted. Values containing spaces must be quoted.
Example: `test_set_type=SCENARIO`
Maximum number of test sets to return (default 50, max 100)
Token for retrieving the next page of results

Field to order results by. Prefix with `-` for descending order.
Example: `-create_time` for newest first

Filter test sets by tags. A resource matches when it has ALL the listed tags (AND-semantics).

Repeat the parameter for each tag (e.g., `?tag_filters=production&tag_filters=regression`).
